[*All chieftainships throughout this agency are hereditary, and the heir to a chieftainship is considered a chief from his
birth, but he requires to make a potlach before succeeding to the powers of a chieftain Second chieftainships are more
family headships than "tribal" chiefs.]

chiefs of the nine tribes, hence the large number of chiefs.
